title: Decoding Deep Time Through a Diagenetic Channel: An Information-Theoretic Recoverability Framework for Speleothem Climate Archives
description: A theoretical recoverability framework and fixed-seed synthetic stress test for inference of climate from speleothem proxy records under structured alteration. No SISAL rows, instrumental cave data, or laboratory measurements were analyzed. The synthetic results establish only behavior under the specified simulator. This JSON is prepared for a possible future Zenodo deposit; it does not represent a deposit and no DOI has been issued.
